name: Feature request
about: Suggest something new for aarambh-vision-studio
title: "[FEATURE] "

assignees: ''
---

**What are you trying to do?**
A clear description of the capability or improvement you're looking for.

**Where would this fit in the existing roadmap?**
Check `ROADMAP_VISION_STUDIO_PART1.md` / `PART2.md` and
`ARCHITECTURE_VISION_STUDIO_PART1.md` / `PART2.md` first — does this
extend an existing phase, or is it genuinely new scope? If it's out of
scope per §30 (ARCHITECTURE Part 2 — video generation, depth/pose
conditioning, real-person likeness cloning, etc.), say so and explain
why it's worth reconsidering.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What would this look like, concretely?

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems best.

**Hardware impact**
Does this require anything beyond the project's i3 + free-tier-Kaggle-GPU
hardware philosophy (see `README.md`)? If so, that's worth flagging up
front — it likely needs a design discussion before implementation.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant — links, references, related work.
